## Activity

During February 2025, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 77 captures. This report summarises activity at the site for the month and provides the associated image-quality and grading results. The capture total is the basis for the image-quality measure reported below.

## Image quality

Of the images reviewed, 4 were assessed as ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 5.2. The ungradable result is reported separately from the grading outcome so that image quality and clinical grading can be monitored as distinct parts of the service process.

## Grading

There were 14 referable results during February 2025. The median lag for grading was 1. This measure records the midpoint of the grading delay for the month and should be considered alongside the volume of captures and the number of ungradable images.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. The available results therefore comprise 77 captures, 4 ungradable images, an ungradable rate of 5.2, 14 referable results and a median lag of 1.
